claims: The Kraken is a legendary sea monster from Scandinavian folklore.
The Kraken is often described as an enormous octopus or giant squid.
The Kraken is capable of dragging entire ships down to the sea floor.
The Kraken originates from tales told by Norwegian sailors.
Giant squid can reach over 10 meters (34 feet) in length.
The Kraken legend began in Norwegian folklore as stories of sea monsters threatening sailors.
The word "kraken" is derived from the Norwegian word "krake".
The Norwegian word "krake" refers to a sickly animal or something twisted.
The Kraken is often depicted as a colossal squid or octopus.
Sailors historically described the Kraken as being up to 2.4 kilometers (1.5 miles) across.
The Kraken is capable of bringing down ships with huge tentacled arms.
The Kraken is featured in films such as 2026's Kraken.
The Kraken is featured in books.
The Kraken is featured in games.
The Kraken is represented as a roller coaster at SeaWorld Orlando.
Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange.

The Seattle Kraken are a professional NHL ice hockey team.
